prompts: Use case: illustration-story. Original landscape 3:2 editorial comparison for an art history website. Frame from waist upward to emphasize the hands. Do not merge the figures or invent a shared shrine. No text, labels, watermark or claims of provenance. Artistic comparison of hand positions, not documentary photography.
